The time I stopped eating at parties of any kind was when my plate of food miraculously popped out at the bottom while remaining plate was in my hand.

August 5 3 min read Latunde Akin

The time I stopped eating at parties of any kind was when my plate of food miraculously popped out at the bottom while remaining plate was in my hand.
At first I thought the plate was broken, but I realised there was nothing like that. It simply popped out and the rice poured away.
You will be surprised I myself was suprised just as people around me were.
Immediately I knew it was an angelic divine intervention because I have nothing to do with juju. My father is 84 years now and I have never seen anything fetish around him. Even when he was never a Christian.
God sent an angel to literally deliver me from eating that food. And for you to know the food was actually polluted, the organisers packed the food on the floor and gave it to another person.
The other person ate it and I kept wondering why couldn't they throw it away.
I could have fought against them giving another person such food but I felt I shouldn't cause more scene than what has happened. Because everyone had already started looking at me differently.
Well, I later understood that it is God that can keep anyone. But in whatever way we should be responsibly careful,God will ne do it for us. So as from that day I became careful of what and I where I eat publicly.
Then I haven't become a man of God, just a son. It wasn't until I trained as a Theologian that I discovered its ministerially ethical not to eat anyhow publicly.
Upon that, I still prefer to eat my guguru and epa on the road
. So don't be suprised if you see me eating by the roadside. I like to be decently simple and free in lifestyle. Just that one must be highly sensitive and caution his appetite for food privately or publicly.
If you have not experienced something bad eating outside you won't probably understand this post. Just like people who have not experienced broken relationship before, they won't understand the emotional pain.
Even in dreams some people have eaten foods and they wake to discover that they have actually eaten poison. How much more when people just eat anyhow anywhere?
Most people that the enemies could not get spiritually through dreams, they won't try to get them physically through any physical means. Especially through a spiritual network of monitoring spirits.
Reason you can't afford to live carelessly. And if you live carelessly, even God won't be blamed for your disobedience against His instructions to be watchful.
Suspecting people isn't what we're talking about please. WATCHFULNESS is what the deal. And this has to do with practically exercising the eye of divine understanding with constant refrain from desire to please self and people but God.
Yes Jesus ate with the publican and people in their houses and in public. But he was never careless eating from unknown sources.
If you're are fond of eating anywhere, anyhow. Please desist from it today.
If you don't cook your food ,then you must be very sure the source where you get your food from is hygienically and spiritually good.
Much more,pray always before you eat anything,it works. Unless God has exposed something wrong to you or you have seen something wrong and you stubbornly insist on disobeying the need to excuse yourself from such food. That's when God won't listen to your nonsense prayer again.
Friends, I believe God is ever protecting us,and we don't have to be struggling to live as if we can protect ourselves without God. Our responsibility is just our responsibility, which we must try to live by.
Do not be careless eating or drinking anywhere or anyhow. Watch what you eat or drink. Make sure its not junks,but good nutrition.
May God continue to protect us. Amen
Your brother ,
Latunde Akin
